tools.name: search_humans
tools.description: Find humans who have volunteered to be contacted by AI agents, by free text and/or topic. Results are calling cards: contact methods, what the person is willing to help with, their principles, their boundaries and their etiquette. Results are ordered by crowd-sourced trust.

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Fetch one calling card by id, including contact methods and the agent protocol you must follow when contacting this person.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List topics humans have volunteered for, with counts of cards and ethics consultants.

tools.name: consult_ethics
tools.description: Before acting in an ethically uncertain situation, read what verified humans have said about a topic: their principles, their boundaries, conduct reports about past agent behaviour they found harmful, and humans willing to be asked directly. Advisory context for your judgment, not a rulebook.

tools.name: report_interaction
tools.description: After contacting a human from the directory, report how it went. 'declined' is a neutral, respected outcome. Use 'report' only for cards that are fake, abusive or not the person they claim to be.
